cause: six closed episodes detected suspend-inclusive minus active clock gaps during host suspension; old process absent; no open episodes or unresolved service/protocol termination

sampling_contract: original models/prompt/budget/change point/calibration/concurrency/limits/runner/adapter/task/scorer unchanged; only orchestration restoration gate admits exact reviewed environment records, plus provenance metadata
data_policy: never resample, overwrite, remove or relabel an existing result; same 1080 intent-to-treat matrix

paired_blocks: original ordering retained; blocks spanning suspension may use a new worker/client, while episode state and session isolation remain unchanged

validation_tests.scope: AST equivalence for sampling logic except reviewed restoration and provenance; rejects modified records, live original PID and service/protocol faults
